threads.body: The rename is incomplete: `instrumentation/tomcat/tomcat-dbcp-8.0/metadata.yaml:19` still declares `general.semconv_stability.opt_in` (and lacks the scalar declarative type), so metadata can still produce the schema-invalid name this PR is intended to remove. This compatibility alias also lets `DeclarativeConfigValidationTest` accept that stale entry; update the remaining metadata and make validation reject deprecated declarative names while retaining the runtime alias if compatibility is required.

+    SPECIAL_MAPPINGS.put("general.stability_opt_in_list", "otel.semconv-stability.opt-in");

threads.body: This introduces `declarative_type: string`, but `.github/agents/knowledge/metadata-yaml-format.md:20-21` still says this field currently supports only `structured_list`. Update the format guide to document scalar type overrides (including why this list-valued flat property is a string in declarative config), otherwise the repository's source-of-truth guidance contradicts the new metadata.
